facts.fact: ANTIC, Cameroon's national agency for information and communication, was restructured by Decree No 2019/150 of 22 March 2019 and runs a Computer Incident Response Team focused on cybersecurity, per the ICTAC newsletter relaying ANTIC.

The document lists Law No 2010/012 relating to cyber criminality in Cameroon as part of the legal framework overseeing cybercrime, with penalties up to 10 years' imprisonment and fines up to 10 million FCFA.
Per ANTIC figures given in 2023, its requests from law enforcement led to the apprehension of suspects in 1,836 cases in 2022, with 673 investigation files forwarded to court.
ANTIC reported for 2022 a count of 1,836 arrests and 673 investigation files sent to court, and 245 cases needing authentication of digital evidence.
